item.title: Ask HN: ChatGPT named chat with Chinese characters
item.summary: This happened just by itself... the chat was related to pip install related issue... no chinese text was there in my question, nor was there any in response.. It seems chatgpt might be using small chinese model for naming these chats lol https://ibb.co/Qvj8JNyL Has any of you experienced this?
